propositions: models_at_or_above and largest_window_tokens fail to locate non-Anthropic-family primaries in the ladder and silently return the entire ladder or ladder maximum instead of an explicit outcome for the unlocated model
Pass-1 escalation downgrades to claude-haiku-4-5 and crosses to Anthropic provider when starting from a non-Anthropic primary, because the primary does not appear in its own returned ladder
largest_window_tokens returns 1000000 (ladder maximum) for an unlocated model instead of a conservative estimate, causing P8 under-blocking and silent truncation during review
prerequisite-coverage escalation also exhibits the defect through the same ladder non-location, attempting to jump to claude-haiku-4-5 instead of staying on the operator's model
The fix returns [model] for truthy-but-unlocated primaries in models_at_or_above and uses ladder minimum for window, preserving single-criterion retry while stopping before cross-family rung climbing
